<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Download one attachment by the part number get lists. --out names the file to write; --out - writes to stdout, which must not be a terminal.

## Usage

```text
chainmail attachment <ref> <part> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail attachment cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 2 --out invoice.pdf
chainmail attachment cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 2 --out - > invoice.pdf
```

## Flags

```text
      --out string   file to write, or - for stdout when it is not a terminal (required)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
